description: collections_search — FamilySearch record collections for Pennsylvania (state-level). collections_search derives the scope (the US state) from the standardPlace itself, so callers pass the full place rather than hand-querying the enclosing state; this fixture returns the collections a Pennsylvania researcher would actually see. Collection 1999196 (Pennsylvania, Probate Records) is served identically in collections-search-schuylkill.json: measured live 2026-09-24 with the collections_search tool (engine build 0.1.0+2026-09-21.22e7d814) for both 'Pennsylvania, United States' and 'Schuylkill, Pennsylvania, United States' as recordCount 0, personCount 52, imageCount 3200560. personCount is deliberately rounded down to 0 here, making it a browse-only image collection for grading. Re-measure with `cd packages/engine/mcp-server && npx tsx dev/try-collections-search.ts`.
